responsibility: This definition file enumerates the SVE2, SVE2 crypto, SVE2 bitperm, SHA3, and SM4 ACLE intrinsic families supported by the AArch64 port. Each DEF_SVE_FUNCTION entry states the intrinsic base name, function shape, permitted type combinations, predication style, and required extension mask, allowing the generic SVE builtin framework to register and gate the SVE2-specific overload set from one declarative table.
same_name_distinction: Within the aarch64-sve-builtins-sve2 trio, this file is the declarative table of SVE2 and extension-specific intrinsic families and their gating flags; unlike the .cc file it does not implement expansion behavior, and unlike the .h file it does not provide extern declarations.
